1	# AI Three-Track Timeline (2010–2024)
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	This dataset captures 15 years of AI evolution across three parallel tracks — research breakthroughs, industry adoption, and regulatory action — alongside annual global private AI investment figures. The data is designed to visualize how these tracks interrelate over time and how their cadence changed around the ChatGPT launch.
     5	
     6	## Data Source
     7	
     8	### research_milestones
     9	22 records. Fields: `year` (int, 2011–2024), `month` (int, 1–12), `event` (string, brief description), `category` (string: NLP, Computer Vision, Generative AI, LLM, Architecture, Training Methods, Reinforcement Learning, Science).
    10	
    11	### industry_milestones
    12	21 records. Fields: `year` (int, 2011–2024), `month` (int, 1–12), `event` (string), `category` (string: Consumer Product, Internal R&D, M&A, Platform, Deployment, Autonomous Systems, Cloud AI, Investment, Developer Tools, Hardware, Enterprise).
    13	
    14	### regulatory_milestones
    15	19 records. Fields: `year` (int, 2016–2024), `month` (int, 1–12), `event` (string), `jurisdiction` (string: US, EU, China, UK, International).
    16	
    17	### global_ai_investment
    18	15 records (one per year, 2010–2024). Fields: `year` (int), `investment_bn_usd` (float, estimated annual global private AI investment in billion USD). Values range from ~$1.3B in 2010 to ~$110B in 2024.
    19	
    20	## Data Notes
    21	- Investment figures are estimates compiled from Stanford HAI AI Index and CB Insights reports; 2024 is a partial-year projection.
    22	- Milestone dates use the earliest public announcement month.
    23	- Regulatory track starts in 2016 as no major AI-specific policy actions preceded that year.

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.dates import DateFormatter, YearLocator, MonthLocator
import datetime
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

research = data['research_milestones']['data']
industry = data['industry_milestones']['data']
regulatory = data['regulatory_milestones']['data']
investment = data['global_ai_investment']['data']

# Convert to datetime
def to_dt(item):
    return datetime.datetime(item['year'], item['month'], 15)

for item in research:
    item['dt'] = to_dt(item)
for item in industry:
    item['dt'] = to_dt(item)
for item in regulatory:
    item['dt'] = to_dt(item)

# Investment to datetime (mid-year)
for item in investment:
    item['dt'] = datetime.datetime(item['year'], 7, 1)

# Color scheme - editorial, professional
COLORS = {
    'research': '#2563EB',      # deep blue
    'industry': '#059669',      # emerald green
    'regulatory': '#DC2626',    # red
    'investment': '#7C3AED',    # violet
    'chatgpt_line': '#F59E0B',  # amber
    'pre_chatgpt': '#F3F4F6',   # light gray bg
    'post_chatgpt': '#E0F2FE',  # light blue bg
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(22, 14))

# Background shading for eras
chatgpt_date = datetime.datetime(2022, 11, 1)
xlim_left = datetime.datetime(2010, 1, 1)
xlim_right = datetime.datetime(2025, 1, 1)

ax.axvspan(xlim_left, chatgpt_date, facecolor=COLORS['pre_chatgpt'], alpha=0.6, zorder=0)
ax.axvspan(chatgpt_date, xlim_right, facecolor=COLORS['post_chatgpt'], alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

# ChatGPT vertical line
ax.axvline(chatgpt_date, color=COLORS['chatgpt_line'], linewidth=3, linestyle='--', zorder=5, alpha=0.9)

    if item['year'] % 2 == 0 or item['year'] >= 2022:
        ax2.text(item['dt'], item['investment_bn_usd'] + 4, f"${item['investment_bn_usd']:.0f}B",
                fontsize=7.5, ha='center', va='bottom', color=COLORS['investment'], fontweight='bold')

ax2.set_ylim(0, 140)
ax2.set_ylabel('Global AI Investment (Billion USD)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color=COLORS['investment'])
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=COLORS['investment'], labelsize=10)
ax2.spines['right'].set_color(COLORS['investment'])
ax2.spines['right'].set_linewidth(2)

# Format x-axis
ax.set_xlim(xlim_left, xlim_right)
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(YearLocator())
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(DateFormatter('%Y'))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(MonthLocator(interval=3))
ax.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=11, rotation=0)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# Remove y-axis (tracks are labeled)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

# Title
fig.suptitle('AI Evolution: Three-Track Timeline (2010–2024)', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.98, color='#111827')
ax.set_title('Research breakthroughs, industry adoption, and regulatory action converge post-ChatGPT,\naccompanied by surging global investment', 
             fontsize=12, color='#4B5563', pad=20, style='italic')

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['research'], edgecolor='white', label='Research Milestones'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['industry'], edgecolor='white', label='Industry Milestones'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['regulatory'], edgecolor='white', label='Regulatory Milestones'),
    mpatches.Patch(facecolor=COLORS['investment'], alpha=0.5, edgecolor=COLORS['investment'], label='Global AI Investment ($B)'),
    plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=COLORS['chatgpt_line'], linewidth=3, linestyle='--', label='ChatGPT Launch (Nov 2022)'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.0, 1.12),
          ncol=5, frameon=True, fancybox=True, shadow=False, fontsize=10,
          facecolor='white', edgecolor='#D1D5DB')

# Era labels
ax.text(datetime.datetime(2016, 6, 1), 0.96, 'Pre-ChatGPT Era', transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),
        fontsize=11, ha='center', va='top', color='#6B7280', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8)
ax.text(datetime.datetime(2023, 9, 1), 0.96, 'Post-ChatGPT Era', transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),
        fontsize=11, ha='center', va='top', color='#0369A1', fontstyle='italic', alpha=0.8, fontweight='bold')

# Density annotation
ax.annotate('Dense regulatory &\nindustry response', 
            xy=(datetime.datetime(2023, 8, 1), TRACK_Y['regulatory'] + 0.05),
            xytext=(datetime.datetime(2023, 8, 1), 0.05),
            transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),
            fontsize=9, ha='center', color=COLORS['regulatory'],
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLORS['regulatory'], lw=1.5),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#FEE2E2', edgecolor=COLORS['regulatory'], alpha=0.8))

# Lag gap annotation for early period
ax.annotate('Multi-year lag:\nResearch → Regulation', 
            xy=(datetime.datetime(2017, 6, 1), TRACK_Y['research']),
            xytext=(datetime.datetime(2014, 1, 1), TRACK_Y['research'] - 0.15),
            transform=ax.get_xaxis_transform(),
            fontsize=9, ha='center', color='#6B7280',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->', color='#6B7280', lw=1.5, connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'),
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.2', facecolor='#F9FAFB', edgecolor='#9CA3AF', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
